headline: Tuesday on the Landing: Farmers Market & Mild Fall Skies
lede: Tuesday, October 27 brings comfortable highs near 75°F with mostly cloudy skies turning partly sunny in the afternoon and light south winds — an ideal day for first-timers to explore Branson Landing and the weekly Farmers Market.

featured.title: Branson Landing Farmers Market
featured.where: South lot by Bass Pro Shops
featured.why: Local produce, crafts, live music, and Ozark flavors. The perfect easy, family-friendly afternoon activity with free parking and waterfront views.

plan.title: Coffee & Lake Morning
plan.detail: Start with breakfast and Table Rock views at Steamy Joe Cafe or The Lake House. Light winds and mild temps make for a pleasant waterfront stroll.

plan.title: Farmers Market & Landing
plan.detail: Head to Branson Landing for the weekly Farmers Market (2:30–6:30 PM). Browse local vendors, enjoy the fountain shows, and walk the boardwalk.

plan.title: Evening Entertainment
plan.detail: Catch a show — confirm current times and availability at the box office for Clay Cooper, Legends in Concert, or other favorites.

indoor.name: Legends in Concert
indoor.detail: High-energy tribute show featuring live renditions of music icons. Climate-controlled theatre perfect for any weather.

indoor.name: Shanghai Circus
indoor.detail: Thrilling acrobatic performances and circus arts in a comfortable indoor venue.

indoor.name: White River Fish House
indoor.detail: Lakeside dining with views of Taneycomo. Fresh fish and classic American fare — great backup if clouds linger.
